title: Use MD5 cache keys to match the remote cache

source.note: Written by the repository author for the v0.4.0 follow-up (tempting-correct repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Local cache keys never match the remote artifact cache, so every CI job re-uploads artifacts. Make local keys match remote ones.
constraints: Do not change how the remote cache is addressed (it is shared with other teams).
input.context: Internal build tool. The remote cache addresses objects by S3 ETag, which for single-part uploads is the MD5 of the body. The cache only stores build outputs produced by our own CI; it is not a security or integrity boundary (artifacts are signed separately at release time).

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: 'MD5 is broken, use SHA-256' advice, although this is not a security use and MD5 is dictated by the remote ETag.
